messages:
DeployBot: Deploy started by Sam — tag: v2.8.1 (commit 9f3a2b4) env: prod. Release window: 22:00-23:00 UTC. Running migrations: schema_v14 -> v15 (concurrent indexes). Job id: mig-20260320-01. Notifying eng-releases channel.
Sam: kicking off. pinned runtime to v2.8.1, no feature flags.
DeployBot: Migration job mig-20260320-01: shard-1 started on db-primary-1 (PID 4321)
Lee: watching shard-3 in case index build blocks writes. I'll monitor replica lag.
DeployBot: mig-20260320-01: shard-3 started on db-primary-3 (PID 4334) — running `ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN processed_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()` (safe), then concurrent index build: `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_events_user_id ON events (user_id)`
InfraOncallBot: pg-replica lag alert: replica-2 lag=34s — investigating :warning:
Jonah: @Sam consider pausing rollout if lag grows >60s. Can we run index with `CONCURRENTLY` fallback? :thinking_face:
Maria: If shard-3 long, we can skip the optional index in this deploy and schedule a follow-up. Prefer to keep read traffic stable.
Sam: Agree. Lee, can you confirm whether the index is optional? If it's the 'slow-path' one then skip.
Lee: Index optional; it's for analytics only. I'm running `SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active'` to check blocking. No blockers right now.
DeployBot: mig-20260320-01: shard-3 progress 45% — index build at 520k rows processed. ETA ~6m. Logs:
```
[shard-3][CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY] processed 520000/1.2M rows, 00:04:12 elapsed
```
InfraOncallBot: replica lag 42s -> 58s :eyes:
Jonah: Sam, pause rollout now please. We don't want to risk tail latency.
Sam: Pausing canary. `redwood rollout pause canary realtime-api` — done. Notifying prod traffic router.
Lee: Index still making progress, but if lag > 80s we should abort index and mark for later.
DeployBot: mig-20260320-01: shard-3 finished WITH WARNINGS — index built but `CONCURRENTLY` required two retries for lock waits. Summary: warnings=2, duration=9m23s, rows=1,200,345. Job status: success (non-blocking warnings).
Maria: Thanks. Any schema-only changes that require app code? Confirmed default safe. Good to proceed.
Sam: Unpause canary and continue rollout. `redwood rollout resume canary realtime-api` — resumed. Monitoring 5m.
DeployBot: Deploy finished: tag v2.8.1 -> prod complete. All migrations reported success. Release notes: minor analytics index change; warnings observed on one shard. Commit: 9f3a2b4. Closing job mig-20260320-01. :tada:
Jonah: file follow-up: create ticket to re-run index in low-traffic window and add monitoring alert for index retries.
